coordinateFrame: Blender x/y equals runtime x/z; metres

fire.design: established irregular stone ring over mineral soil; small fire; runtime owns flame, smoke, and light

communalZone.rule: Keep the camp-spur arrival and the south side of the fire open; sleeping pitches occupy one quiet north/east arc.

sources.rule: If no existing pit is available and fires are permitted, select a site at least 15 feet from tents, shrubs, trees, and other flammables.
Clear litter, duff, and burnable material within a 10-foot circle; keep the fire small and water available.
Prefer an existing fire ring in an established campsite and place tents on durable, already impacted surfaces.
